About the M4A4 | Buzz Kill

More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been spray-painted in a zebra stripe pattern. The M4A4 | Buzz Kill is a Covert-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Buzz Kill finish on the M4A4. With a Covert rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.26% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The M4A4 | Buzz Kill can be unboxed from the Glove Case. It belongs to the Glove Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.70. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The M4A4 | Buzz Kill (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $217.49, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $78.85 (Battle-Scarred) to $217.49 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The M4A4 | Buzz Kill has a community rating of 4.0 out of 5 based on 12,371 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among M4A4 skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the M4A4 | Buzz Kill?

Factory New (FN) M4A4 | Buzz Kill skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Buzz Kill pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the M4A4 | Buzz Kill worth the price?

The M4A4 | Buzz Kill sits in the mid-to-high price bracket. It features a distinctive Buzz Kill design that stands out in-game and maintains good trading liquidity. It's part of the The Glove Collection, obtainable from the Glove Case, which adds to its collectible appeal. For players who main the M4A4, this skin offers an excellent balance of visual appeal and investment stability compared to budget alternatives.

What is the float value range for the M4A4 | Buzz Kill?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 0.70, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the M4A4 | Buzz Kill?

Prices for the M4A4 | Buzz Kill vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. This skin can be obtained by opening the Glove Case or purchased directly from third-party marketplaces. The Steam Community Market charges 15% fees, while third-party markets like Skinport, DMarket, and Buff163 offer lower prices with 2-10% fees. Investment potential depends on several factors. The M4A4 | Buzz Kill is from the The Glove Collection (Glove Case) — skins from discontinued collections tend to appreciate as supply decreases over time. Past performance doesn't guarantee future returns, but the M4A4 | Buzz Kill has maintained steady trading interest. Diversifying across multiple items typically reduces risk.

Can I use the M4A4 | Buzz Kill in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the M4A4 | Buzz Kill are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.

Is the M4A4 | Buzz Kill price going up or down?

The M4A4 | Buzz Kill has remained relatively stable in price recently, with less than 5% movement over the past 7 and 30 days. Stable pricing suggests balanced supply and demand. The M4A4 | Buzz Kill is part of the The Glove Collection. It can be obtained by opening the Glove Case. All skins from the same collection share a rarity hierarchy, which affects trade-up contract possibilities and overall value.
